args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export missing the first week when created early
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly case unconditionally advances by 7 days without checking whether the calculated time is strictly after `from`. When a schedule is created on the same day before the run hour, `next` is in the future but not strictly greater than `from`, causing the scheduler to miss the first occurrence and wait another week. Add the same check as daily (`if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate() + 7);`) so that a schedule created before the run hour on its start day runs immediately.
